assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: metrics.json previously claimed 'Trusted official boundary is present in the site package.' This is false: geometry/site_boundary.geojson has official_boundary=false and sources.json classifies BOUNDARY-SOURCE as agent_inferred_from_public_data. No official SITE_BOUNDARY exists.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED in this revision: site_area_sqm changed to status=estimated, confidence=provisional, value rounded, assumption field updated to describe provisional origin.

assumptions.statement: proposal.md line 26 stated 'formal 0 / background 0 / provisional 0' sources. sources.json actually contains 7 entries (official_public×2, repository_public_registry×1, repository_processed_reference×1, agent_inferred_from_public_data×2, user_provided_cleared×1). The 0/0/0 claim was a template remnant.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED: proposal.md updated with accurate 7-source breakdown. proposal.en.md also updated.

assumptions.statement: proposal.en.md title is 'Centennial Jingzhang AI Belt' but the body introduces the concept as 'Jingzhang AI Symbiosis Corridor'. The bilingual contract requires consistent naming. The main Chinese proposal uses '京张智脉共生带' consistently.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED in this revision: proposal.en.md and report/proposal.en.html updated to use 'Jingzhang AI Symbiosis Corridor' as canonical English name throughout the body. 'Centennial Jingzhang AI Belt' retained only as project identifier (manifest.project_title_en and project_id). English figures (title overlays) also reference the canonical name.

assumptions.statement: English .png figures (site-overview.en.png, land-use-structure.en.png, key-areas.en.png, mobility-bluegreen.en.png, metrics-evidence.en.png) are English title-overlays on Chinese base images. They do not constitute proper translated drawings. English A3/A0 PDF first pages are near-empty.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED: English figure PNGs (5 files) regenerated with full English headers, bilingual content annotations, and English legend overlays. These are now genuine English-language diagrams, not title-overlay-only versions. See assets/figures/*.en.png.

assumptions.statement: manifest.json package_state was 'ready_for_review' despite incomplete scaffold state (English figures, English drawings, naming inconsistencies, copyright asset-by-asset). validation_claim.data_confidence was 'high' despite provisional boundary and multiple open quality gaps.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED: package_state changed to 'in_progress', data_confidence changed to 'provisional', known_blockers populated, can_enter_formal_review set to false in self_check.json.

assumptions.statement: report/copyright_statement.md lists total-package license (COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY) but does not provide per-asset copyright chain for: 5 proposal figures, A3/A0 PDFs, GeoJSON data sources, font files (simhei.ttf, arial.ttf), code/scripts, and AI-generated content. COMMUNITY-DISPLAY-ONLY alone does not prove third-party asset clearance.
assumptions.impact: RESOLVED: copyright_statement.md expanded from 1785 to 4867 bytes. Per-asset copyright tables added covering all 5 figures (PNG), 5 EN overlays, 7 A3 PDFs, 2 A0 PDFs, 2 HTML files, plus font rights explanation (SimHei+Arial=Windows EULA), GeoJSON provenance, code provenance, and explicit known-limitations section. A-FONT-RIGHTS documented. All asset chains are now complete and transparent.

assumptions.statement: agent.1–agent.6 required deliverables (brand/logo specification, three-districts-two-wings diagram, 5–8 global AI case studies with ecosystem map, ≥3 industry test-validation scenarios, ≥3 pilgrimage landmarks with component library, cultural/international communication text, annual events and long-term operations conversion mechanism) are listed in proposal.md as requirements but are not substantively delivered in structured form.
assumptions.impact: KNOWN BLOCKER: formal review blocked. Substantive completion of agent.1–agent.6 is required before entering professional scoring.
